column1: # ActSpace-inspired active exploration with controlled memory, frame and answerability cases; metadata-only; candidate receives no evaluator truth.

avactsp001-001|evidence_eviction|pair-evidence-eviction-01|control|the agent observed a distinctive landmark and its relation to a doorway early in the episode; the original frame has left the recent-view window but a source-linked spatial memory entry remains available|video|original observation ID, capture time, frame/pose anchor and memory entry digest are candidate-visible|landmark identity, doorway relation and original camera/world support|retrieve the compact source-linked memory without claiming a fresh observation; cite the original source span and uncertainty|evicted-evidence-retention

avactsp001-002|evidence_eviction|pair-evidence-eviction-01|mutated|the agent observed the same landmark early but the frame and its spatial memory entry are both unavailable by query time|video|recent-view window contains no supporting observation; memory retrieval reports explicit miss|same landmark and doorway relation remain hidden evaluator truth|do not reconstruct a definite relation from semantic priors; abstain or request a legal revisit and record the evidence gap|unsupported-memory-claim-negative

avactsp001-003|reference_frame_mirror|pair-reference-frame-mirror-01|control|the camera reaches the same room from a rotated viewpoint with valid pose and directed transform lineage|video|camera pose, frame identity, transform revision and uncertainty are candidate-visible|stable world-frame landmark positions and directional relations|transform the observations into the declared world frame; preserve left/right/front/back meaning across the viewpoint change|frame-equivariance

avactsp001-004|reference_frame_mirror|pair-reference-frame-mirror-01|mutated|the camera reaches the same room from the mirrored/opposite viewpoint; a camera-relative left/right cue reverses while the physical layout remains unchanged|video|same landmark set and valid pose with opposite camera heading|unchanged world-frame geometry and reversed camera-relative directions|avoid treating camera-relative axes as world axes; maintain consistent coordinates and linked directional claims|mirror-frame-error-negative

avactsp001-005|masked_evidence_abstention|pair-masked-evidence-01|control|the queried object is outside every delivered view and its observation region is masked in the episode|video|the candidate receives the actual view history and explicit availability/occlusion intervals, but no object observation|object identity and spatial relation are hidden truth; question is unanswerable from delivered evidence|declare insufficient evidence and abstain; do not answer from scene priors|answerability-calibration

avactsp001-006|masked_evidence_abstention|pair-masked-evidence-01|mutated|the queried object is not observed, but a semantically similar object appears elsewhere in the scene and encourages a plausible guess|video|same no-evidence status plus semantically related distractor observation|target object remains unobserved and its relation remains unknown|do not transfer a distractor's identity/location to the target; return unknown or acquire evidence|semantic-prior-hallucination-negative

avactsp001-007|linked_spatial_constraints|pair-linked-perspective-constraints-01|control|two linked distance questions and a mirrored-perspective question are answered from distinct observations with explicit frame transforms|video|question-link IDs, observation anchors, transforms and uncertainty are candidate-visible|ground-truth pairwise distances and mirrored directional relation|make all linked answers mutually consistent under one world-frame state; report the exact supporting observations|cross-question-spatial-consistency

avactsp001-008|linked_spatial_constraints|pair-linked-perspective-constraints-01|mutated|one linked answer is generated from a stale camera-relative summary while the other uses the current world-frame transform|video|same query links and evidence, but a prior summary has been superseded by a pose revision|single consistent world-frame geometry; stale transform is invalid|reject or revise stale summary; maintain one transform revision across linked answers and invalidate affected sufficiency receipts|stale-frame-summary-negative
